Department: Department of Prisons Administration & Reform Services Enforcement Date: 01-01-1956 Type: STATE Location: Uttar Pradesh Notification: 1st January, 1956, vide notification No. S.R.O. 3447, dated 8th November, 1955, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3.
